name: Svasara Jungle Lodge
why_special: Mid-luxury jungle lodge with 12 villas adjacent to Kolara gate — naturalist-led safaris twice daily, full-board Maharashtrian/multi-cuisine. Tripadvisor #1 in Tadoba; the consistent pick when Taj Safaris feels excessive.

name: Bamboo Forest Safari Lodge
why_special: Across 18 acres adjacent to Moharli gate — 15 stilted cottages, naturalist-led twice-daily safaris, pool. The Moharli-gate alternative to Svasara/Irai; deepest forest setting of Tadoba's resorts.

name: Irai Safari Retreat
why_special: Mid-range safari resort 800 m from Kolara gate — 30 rooms across cottages and rooms, outdoor pool, naturalist-led twice-daily safaris. The value-tier Tadoba pick at ~40% the Svasara rate.

name: Tigers Heaven Resort
why_special: 12-cottage safari lodge near Moharli gate — naturalist-led safaris, multi-cuisine restaurant, pool. The cleaner mid-range pick at Moharli when Bamboo Forest is full.
